# Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash

Z.AI's GLM 5.3 Flash is a multimodal 320B-parameter (18B active) Mixture-of-Experts model. Built for developer agent workflows, visual coding, and complex tool-use tasks. The model is served without Mistral modifications.

- API names: `zai-glm-5-3-flash`
- Status: GA
- Type: Open, Generalist
- Release date: 2026-10-22
- Version: 5.3-flash
- Context length: 1M
- Output token limit: 128k
- Input: text, image
- Output: reasoning, text
- Features: structured-outputs, function-calling, document-qna, prefix, chat-completions, batching, agents-conversations, connectors
- Speed rating: 5/5
- Performance rating: 5/5
- Pricing: Input $0.15 /M Tokens; Cached input $0.03 /M Tokens; Output $0.5 /M Tokens
- Licenses: MIT
- Open weights: [Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash), 320B parameters, 18B active, MIT

# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017

# Z.ai GLM 5.3

A third-party open weight text model from Z.ai, hosted by Mistral for long-context coding and agentic workflows. The model is served without Mistral modifications.

- API names: `zai-glm-5-3`, `zai-glm-5`, `zai-glm-latest`
- Status: GA
- Type: Open, Generalist
- Release date: 2026-09-15
- Version: 5.3

- Output token limit: 128k

- Speed rating: 5/5

- Licenses: MIT
- Open weights: [Z.ai GLM 5.3](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3), 753B parameters, 40B active, MIT

# Shieldstral 1.0

A compact multimodal moderation model for prompt moderation, response moderation, prompt-response pair classification, refusal detection, and safety filtering across text and image inputs. It uses natural-language policy questions and returns a yes or no classification.

- Status: Public Preview
- Type: Labs, Specialist
- Release date: 2026-08-04
- Version: 1.0
- Context length: 32k
- Parameters: 3.8B total and active
- Input: text, image
- Output: text
- Licenses: Apache 2.0
- Open weights: [Weights](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Shieldstral-1.0), 3.8B parameters, Apache 2.0

# Timestral 1.0 209M

Timestral 1.0 209M is a time series foundation model for zero-shot forecasting. It ranks first among pretrained and zero-shot models on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, with support for contexts up to 32K timesteps, past-only and known-future covariates, and probabilistic quantile outputs.

- Status: Public Preview
- Type: Premier, Specialist
- Version: 1.0
- Context length: 32K
- Parameters: 209M total and active
- Input: timeseries
- Output: timeseries
- Licenses: Modified MIT
- Open weights: [Weights](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Timestral-209M), 209M parameters, Modified MIT

# Timestral 1.0 123M

Timestral 1.0 123M is a time series foundation model for zero-shot forecasting. Part of the Timestral family, it offers a balance of forecast accuracy and efficiency, with support for contexts up to 32K timesteps, past-only and known-future covariates, and probabilistic quantile outputs.

- Status: Public Preview
- Type: Premier, Specialist
- Version: 1.0
- Context length: 32K
- Parameters: 123M total and active
- Input: timeseries
- Output: timeseries
- Licenses: Modified MIT
- Open weights: [Weights](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Timestral-123M), 123M parameters, Modified MIT

# Timestral 1.0 28M

Timestral 1.0 28M is a time series foundation model for zero-shot forecasting. Part of the Timestral family, it is optimised for low-latency forecasting, with support for contexts up to 32K timesteps, past-only and known-future covariates, and probabilistic quantile outputs.

- Status: Public Preview
- Type: Premier, Specialist
- Version: 1.0
- Context length: 32K
